neighbours.label: word-initial capital ' E' piece of a split word or acronym (Ecosystems, EEA, ECONOMIC)
fire: The book on Whales and Ocean Ecosystems was reprinted in 2007.
Norway is one of the EEA member countries outside the EU.
The policy treats water as an ECONOMIC GOOD for the first time.
Her course covers Ecology, Eukaryota and soil microbiology.
Officials from the EFTA states met in Geneva on Monday.
The lab sequenced several Escherichia strains from the river.
Students read the chapter on Ecosystem Services before class.
The ESA mission will study comets in the outer system.
quiet: The book on Whales and Ocean Habitats was reprinted in 2007.
Norway is one of the Nordic member countries outside the EU.
The policy treats water as a PUBLIC GOOD for the first time.
Her course covers Botany, Zoology and soil microbiology.
Officials from the Nordic states met in Geneva on Monday.
The lab sequenced several Salmonella strains from the river.
Students read the chapter on Habitat Loss before class.
The NASA mission will study comets in the outer system.

notes: ' E' 15 of top 32; - pole is lowercase ' e'/' é' (eMedicine, éditions). Tokenization not checked.
